---
title: "Pass the configured customers and carts slugs to the payment endpoints"
description: "Drop when the pinned release passes customersSlug and cartsSlug from the plugin config to the initiate and confirm-order handlers."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.2. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

A site whose customers log in through their own collection gets the wrong
owner on every transaction. The plugin builds the initiate and confirm-order
handlers without `customersSlug`, so adapters receive the default `users`
whatever `customers.slug` says. An adapter that attaches `req.user` only when
it belongs to the customers collection treats a real customer as a guest and
an admin user as the customer. Initiate also loses the carts slug from
`slugMap`, so it looks up the cart in `carts`.

The plugin now passes `collectionSlugMap.customers` to both handlers and
`collectionSlugMap.carts` to initiate, as it already does for the other
slugs.

- **Patch:** `ecommerce-adapter-customers-slug`, committed as `fix(plugin-ecommerce): pass the configured customers and carts slugs to the payment endpoints`
- **Upstream:** Not proposed
- **Tests:** `pnpm exec vitest run --project unit packages/plugin-ecommerce/src/index.spec.ts; e2e suite (tests/checkout.spec.ts, the tests that a logged-in customer owns a checkout and an admin user never does)`
- **Diff:** [`upstream/patches/0015-fix-plugin-ecommerce-pass-the-configured-customers-a.patch`](https://github.com/AdiRishi/offload-cms/blob/main/upstream/patches/0015-fix-plugin-ecommerce-pass-the-configured-customers-a.patch)
